abbott_smith_html:
χριστός (Χρ-), -ή, -όν
(χρίω), [in LXX for מָשִׁיחַ and cogn. forms ;]
__1. 1. as adj.,
__(a) of things, anointing, to be used as ointment (Æsch., Eur., al.; τ. ἔλαιον τὸ χ., Lev.21:10);
__(b) of persons, anointed (ὁ ἰερεὺς ὁ χ., Lev.4:5; οἱ χ. ἰευρεῖς, 2Ma.1:10): ὁ χ. τοῦ κυρίου or Θεοῦ (1Ki.2:10, Psa.2:2, al.), of the Messiah (Aram., מְשִׁיחָא; cf. Dalman, Words, 289 ff.), Luk.2:11, 26 Jhn.1:41, Act.2:36 4:26, al.
__2. As subst., ὁ Χριστός, the Messiah, the Christ: Mat.2:4, Mrk.8:29, Luk.2:11, Jhn.1:20, Act.2:31, Rom.7:4, al.; Ἰησοῦς, Mrk.1:1, Jhn.1:17, Act.2:38, al.; Χ. Ἰησοῦς, Mat.1:18, WH, mg. Act.5:42, Rom.6:3, al.; Χ. κύριος, Luk.2:11; Ἰησοῦς Χ. ὁ κύριος, Act.15:26, Rom.1:7, al.
(AS)

strongs_1890.strongs_def: anointed, i.e. the Messiah, an epithet of Jesus

occurrences.bsb: Who is there to condemn us? For Christ Jesus, who died, and more than that was raised to life, is at the right hand of God—and He is interceding for us.
occurrences.kjv: Who is he that condemneth? It is Christ that died, yea rather, that is risen again, who is even at the right hand of God, who also maketh intercession for us.

occurrences.bsb: Who shall separate us from the love of Christ? Shall trouble or distress or persecution or famine or nakedness or danger or sword?
occurrences.kjv: Who shall separate us from the love of Christ? shall tribulation, or distress, or persecution, or famine, or nakedness, or peril, or sword?

occurrences.bsb: neither height nor depth, nor anything else in all creation, will be able to separate us from the love of God that is in Christ Jesus our Lord.
occurrences.kjv: Nor height, nor depth, nor any other creature, shall be able to separate us from the love of God, which is in Christ Jesus our Lord.

occurrences.bsb: I speak the truth in Christ; I am not lying, as confirmed by my conscience in the Holy Spirit.
occurrences.kjv: I say the truth in Christ, I lie not, my conscience also bearing me witness in the Holy Ghost,

occurrences.bsb: For I could wish that I myself were cursed and cut off from Christ for the sake of my brothers, my own flesh and blood,
occurrences.kjv: For I could wish that myself were accursed from Christ for my brethren, my kinsmen according to the flesh:

occurrences.bsb: Theirs are the patriarchs, and from them proceeds the human descent of Christ, who is God over all, forever worthy of praise! Amen.
occurrences.kjv: Whose are the fathers, and of whom as concerning the flesh Christ came, who is over all, God blessed for ever. Amen.

occurrences.bsb: For Christ is the end of the law, to bring righteousness to everyone who believes.
occurrences.kjv: For Christ is the end of the law for righteousness to every one that believeth.

occurrences.bsb: But the righteousness that is by faith says: “Do not say in your heart, ‘Who will ascend into heaven?’ (that is, to bring Christ down)
occurrences.kjv: But the righteousness which is of faith speaketh on this wise, Say not in thine heart, Who shall ascend into heaven? (that is, to bring Christ down from above:)

occurrences.bsb: or, ‘Who will descend into the Abyss?’ (that is, to bring Christ up from the dead).”
occurrences.kjv: Or, Who shall descend into the deep? (that is, to bring up Christ again from the dead.)

occurrences.bsb: Consequently, faith comes by hearing, and hearing by the word of Christ.
occurrences.kjv: So then faith cometh by hearing, and hearing by the word of God.

occurrences.bsb: so in Christ we who are many are one body, and each member belongs to one another.
occurrences.kjv: So we, being many, are one body in Christ, and every one members one of another.

occurrences.bsb: Instead, clothe yourselves with the Lord Jesus Christ, and make no provision for the desires of the flesh.
occurrences.kjv: But put ye on the Lord Jesus Christ, and make not provision for the flesh, to fulfil the lusts thereof.

occurrences.bsb: For this reason Christ died and returned to life, that He might be the Lord of both the dead and the living.
occurrences.kjv: For to this end Christ both died, and rose, and revived, that he might be Lord both of the dead and living.

occurrences.bsb: If your brother is distressed by what you eat, you are no longer acting in love. Do not by your eating destroy your brother, for whom Christ died.
occurrences.kjv: But if thy brother be grieved with thy meat, now walkest thou not charitably. Destroy not him with thy meat, for whom Christ died.

occurrences.bsb: For whoever serves Christ in this way is pleasing to God and approved by men.
occurrences.kjv: For he that in these things serveth Christ is acceptable to God, and approved of men.

occurrences.bsb: For even Christ did not please Himself, but as it is written: “The insults of those who insult You have fallen on Me.”
occurrences.kjv: For even Christ pleased not himself; but, as it is written, The reproaches of them that reproached thee fell on me.

occurrences.bsb: Now may the God who gives endurance and encouragement grant you harmony with one another in Christ Jesus,
occurrences.kjv: Now the God of patience and consolation grant you to be likeminded one toward another according to Christ Jesus:

occurrences.bsb: so that with one mind and one voice you may glorify the God and Father of our Lord Jesus Christ.
occurrences.kjv: That ye may with one mind and one mouth glorify God, even the Father of our Lord Jesus Christ.

occurrences.bsb: Accept one another, then, just as Christ accepted you, in order to bring glory to God.
occurrences.kjv: Wherefore receive ye one another, as Christ also received us to the glory of God.

occurrences.bsb: For I tell you that Christ has become a servant of the circumcised on behalf of God’s truth, to confirm the promises made to the patriarchs,
occurrences.kjv: Now I say that Jesus Christ was a minister of the circumcision for the truth of God, to confirm the promises made unto the fathers:

occurrences.bsb: to be a minister of Christ Jesus to the Gentiles in the priestly service of the gospel of God, so that the Gentiles might become an offering acceptable to God, sanctified by the Holy Spirit.
occurrences.kjv: That I should be the minister of Jesus Christ to the Gentiles, ministering the gospel of God, that the offering up of the Gentiles might be acceptable, being sanctified by the Holy Ghost.

occurrences.bsb: Therefore I exult in Christ Jesus in my service to God.
occurrences.kjv: I have therefore whereof I may glory through Jesus Christ in those things which pertain to God.

occurrences.bsb: I will not presume to speak of anything except what Christ has accomplished through me in leading the Gentiles to obedience by word and deed,
occurrences.kjv: For I will not dare to speak of any of those things which Christ hath not wrought by me, to make the Gentiles obedient, by word and deed,

occurrences.bsb: by the power of signs and wonders, and by the power of the Spirit of God. So from Jerusalem all the way around to Illyricum, I have fully proclaimed the gospel of Christ.
occurrences.kjv: Through mighty signs and wonders, by the power of the Spirit of God; so that from Jerusalem, and round about unto Illyricum, I have fully preached the gospel of Christ.

occurrences.bsb: In this way I have aspired to preach the gospel where Christ was not known, so that I would not be building on someone else’s foundation.
occurrences.kjv: Yea, so have I strived to preach the gospel, not where Christ was named, lest I should build upon another man’s foundation:

occurrences.bsb: I know that when I come to you, I will come in the fullness of the blessing of Christ.
occurrences.kjv: And I am sure that, when I come unto you, I shall come in the fulness of the blessing of the gospel of Christ.

occurrences.bsb: Now I urge you, brothers, by our Lord Jesus Christ and by the love of the Spirit, to join me in my struggle by praying to God for me.
occurrences.kjv: Now I beseech you, brethren, for the Lord Jesus Christ’s sake, and for the love of the Spirit, that ye strive together with me in your prayers to God for me;

occurrences.bsb: Greet Prisca and Aquila, my fellow workers in Christ Jesus,
occurrences.kjv: Greet Priscilla and Aquila my helpers in Christ Jesus:

occurrences.bsb: Greet also the church that meets at their house. Greet my beloved Epenetus, who was the first convert to Christ in the province of Asia.
occurrences.kjv: Likewise greet the church that is in their house. Salute my wellbeloved Epenetus, who is the firstfruits of Achaia unto Christ.

occurrences.bsb: Greet Andronicus and Junia, my fellow countrymen and fellow prisoners. They are outstanding among the apostles, and they were in Christ before I was.
occurrences.kjv: Salute Andronicus and Junia, my kinsmen, and my fellowprisoners, who are of note among the apostles, who also were in Christ before me.

occurrences.bsb: Greet Urbanus, our fellow worker in Christ, and my beloved Stachys.
occurrences.kjv: Salute Urbane, our helper in Christ, and Stachys my beloved.

occurrences.bsb: Greet Apelles, who is approved in Christ. Greet those who belong to the household of Aristobulus.
occurrences.kjv: Salute Apelles approved in Christ. Salute them which are of Aristobulus’ household.

occurrences.bsb: Greet one another with a holy kiss. All the churches of Christ send you greetings.
occurrences.kjv: Salute one another with an holy kiss. The churches of Christ salute you.

occurrences.bsb: For such people are not serving our Lord Christ, but their own appetites. By smooth talk and flattery they deceive the hearts of the naive.
occurrences.kjv: For they that are such serve not our Lord Jesus Christ, but their own belly; and by good words and fair speeches deceive the hearts of the simple.

occurrences.bsb: The God of peace will soon crush Satan under your feet. The grace of our Lord Jesus Christ be with you.
occurrences.kjv: And the God of peace shall bruise Satan under your feet shortly. The grace of our Lord Jesus Christ be with you. Amen.
The grace of our Lord Jesus Christ be with you all. Amen.

occurrences.bsb: Paul, called to be an apostle of Christ Jesus by the will of God, and our brother Sosthenes,
occurrences.kjv: Paul, called to be an apostle of Jesus Christ through the will of God, and Sosthenes our brother,

occurrences.bsb: To the church of God in Corinth, to those sanctified in Christ Jesus and called to be holy, together with all those everywhere who call on the name of our Lord Jesus Christ, their Lord and ours:
occurrences.kjv: Unto the church of God which is at Corinth, to them that are sanctified in Christ Jesus, called to be saints, with all that in every place call upon the name of Jesus Christ our Lord, both theirs and ours:

occurrences.bsb: Grace and peace to you from God our Father and the Lord Jesus Christ.
occurrences.kjv: Grace be unto you, and peace, from God our Father, and from the Lord Jesus Christ.

occurrences.bsb: I always thank my God for you because of the grace He has given you in Christ Jesus.
occurrences.kjv: I thank my God always on your behalf, for the grace of God which is given you by Jesus Christ;

occurrences.bsb: because our testimony about Christ was confirmed in you.
occurrences.kjv: Even as the testimony of Christ was confirmed in you:

occurrences.bsb: Therefore you do not lack any spiritual gift as you eagerly await the revelation of our Lord Jesus Christ.
occurrences.kjv: So that ye come behind in no gift; waiting for the coming of our Lord Jesus Christ:

occurrences.bsb: He will sustain you to the end, so that you will be blameless on the day of our Lord Jesus Christ.
occurrences.kjv: Who shall also confirm you unto the end, that ye may be blameless in the day of our Lord Jesus Christ.

occurrences.bsb: God, who has called you into fellowship with His Son Jesus Christ our Lord, is faithful.
occurrences.kjv: God is faithful, by whom ye were called unto the fellowship of his Son Jesus Christ our Lord.

occurrences.bsb: I appeal to you, brothers, in the name of our Lord Jesus Christ, that all of you agree together, so that there may be no divisions among you and that you may be united in mind and conviction.
occurrences.kjv: Now I beseech you, brethren, by the name of our Lord Jesus Christ, that ye all speak the same thing, and that there be no divisions among you; but that ye be perfectly joined together in the same mind and in the same judgment.

occurrences.bsb: What I mean is this: Individuals among you are saying, “I follow Paul,” “I follow Apollos,” “I follow Cephas,” or “I follow Christ.”
occurrences.kjv: Now this I say, that every one of you saith, I am of Paul; and I of Apollos; and I of Cephas; and I of Christ.

occurrences.bsb: Is Christ divided? Was Paul crucified for you? Were you baptized into the name of Paul?
occurrences.kjv: Is Christ divided? was Paul crucified for you? or were ye baptized in the name of Paul?

occurrences.bsb: For Christ did not send me to baptize, but to preach the gospel, not with words of wisdom, lest the cross of Christ be emptied of its power.
occurrences.kjv: For Christ sent me not to baptize, but to preach the gospel: not with wisdom of words, lest the cross of Christ should be made of none effect.

occurrences.bsb: but we preach Christ crucified, a stumbling block to Jews and foolishness to Gentiles,
occurrences.kjv: But we preach Christ crucified, unto the Jews a stumblingblock, and unto the Greeks foolishness;

occurrences.bsb: but to those who are called, both Jews and Greeks, Christ the power of God and the wisdom of God.
occurrences.kjv: But unto them which are called, both Jews and Greeks, Christ the power of God, and the wisdom of God.

occurrences.bsb: It is because of Him that you are in Christ Jesus, who has become for us wisdom from God: our righteousness, holiness, and redemption.
occurrences.kjv: But of him are ye in Christ Jesus, who of God is made unto us wisdom, and righteousness, and sanctification, and redemption:

occurrences.bsb: For I resolved to know nothing while I was with you except Jesus Christ and Him crucified.
occurrences.kjv: For I determined not to know any thing among you, save Jesus Christ, and him crucified.

occurrences.bsb: “For who has known the mind of the Lord, so as to instruct Him?” But we have the mind of Christ.
occurrences.kjv: For who hath known the mind of the Lord, that he may instruct him? But we have the mind of Christ.

occurrences.bsb: Brothers, I could not address you as spiritual, but as worldly—as infants in Christ.
occurrences.kjv: And I, brethren, could not speak unto you as unto spiritual, but as unto carnal, even as unto babes in Christ.

occurrences.bsb: For no one can lay a foundation other than the one already laid, which is Jesus Christ.
occurrences.kjv: For other foundation can no man lay than that is laid, which is Jesus Christ.

occurrences.bsb: and you belong to Christ, and Christ belongs to God.
occurrences.kjv: And ye are Christ’s; and Christ is God’s.

occurrences.bsb: So then, men ought to regard us as servants of Christ and stewards of the mysteries of God.
occurrences.kjv: Let a man so account of us, as of the ministers of Christ, and stewards of the mysteries of God.

occurrences.bsb: We are fools for Christ, but you are wise in Christ. We are weak, but you are strong. You are honored, but we are dishonored.
occurrences.kjv: We are fools for Christ’s sake, but ye are wise in Christ; we are weak, but ye are strong; ye are honourable, but we are despised.

occurrences.bsb: Even if you have ten thousand guardians in Christ, you do not have many fathers; for in Christ Jesus I became your father through the gospel.
occurrences.kjv: For though ye have ten thousand instructors in Christ, yet have ye not many fathers: for in Christ Jesus I have begotten you through the gospel.

occurrences.bsb: That is why I have sent you Timothy, my beloved and faithful child in the Lord. He will remind you of my way of life in Christ Jesus, which is exactly what I teach everywhere in every church.
occurrences.kjv: For this cause have I sent unto you Timotheus, who is my beloved son, and faithful in the Lord, who shall bring you into remembrance of my ways which be in Christ, as I teach every where in every church.

occurrences.bsb: Get rid of the old leaven, that you may be a new unleavened batch, as you really are. For Christ, our Passover lamb, has been sacrificed.
occurrences.kjv: Purge out therefore the old leaven, that ye may be a new lump, as ye are unleavened. For even Christ our passover is sacrificed for us:

occurrences.bsb: Do you not know that your bodies are members of Christ? Shall I then take the members of Christ and unite them with a prostitute? Never!
occurrences.kjv: Know ye not that your bodies are the members of Christ? shall I then take the members of Christ, and make them the members of an harlot? God forbid.

occurrences.bsb: For he who was a slave when he was called by the Lord is the Lord’s freedman. Conversely, he who was a free man when he was called is Christ’s slave.
occurrences.kjv: For he that is called in the Lord, being a servant, is the Lord’s freeman: likewise also he that is called, being free, is Christ’s servant.

occurrences.bsb: yet for us there is but one God, the Father, from whom all things came and for whom we exist. And there is but one Lord, Jesus Christ, through whom all things came and through whom we exist.
occurrences.kjv: But to us there is but one God, the Father, of whom are all things, and we in him; and one Lord Jesus Christ, by whom are all things, and we by him.

occurrences.bsb: So this weak brother, for whom Christ died, is destroyed by your knowledge.
occurrences.kjv: And through thy knowledge shall the weak brother perish, for whom Christ died?

occurrences.bsb: By sinning against your brothers in this way and wounding their weak conscience, you sin against Christ.
occurrences.kjv: But when ye sin so against the brethren, and wound their weak conscience, ye sin against Christ.

occurrences.bsb: If others have this right to your support, shouldn’t we have it all the more? But we did not exercise this right. Instead, we put up with anything rather than hinder the gospel of Christ.
occurrences.kjv: If others be partakers of this power over you, are not we rather? Nevertheless we have not used this power; but suffer all things, lest we should hinder the gospel of Christ.

occurrences.bsb: To those without the law I became like one without the law (though I am not outside the law of God but am under the law of Christ), to win those without the law.
occurrences.kjv: To them that are without law, as without law, (being not without law to God, but under the law to Christ,) that I might gain them that are without law.

occurrences.bsb: and drank the same spiritual drink; for they drank from the spiritual rock that accompanied them, and that rock was Christ.
occurrences.kjv: And did all drink the same spiritual drink: for they drank of that spiritual Rock that followed them: and that Rock was Christ.

occurrences.bsb: We should not test Christ, as some of them did, and were killed by snakes.
occurrences.kjv: Neither let us tempt Christ, as some of them also tempted, and were destroyed of serpents.

occurrences.bsb: Is not the cup of blessing that we bless a participation in the blood of Christ? And is not the bread that we break a participation in the body of Christ?
occurrences.kjv: The cup of blessing which we bless, is it not the communion of the blood of Christ? The bread which we break, is it not the communion of the body of Christ?

occurrences.bsb: You are to imitate me, just as I imitate Christ.
occurrences.kjv: Be ye followers of me, even as I also am of Christ.

occurrences.bsb: But I want you to understand that the head of every man is Christ, and the head of the woman is man, and the head of Christ is God.
occurrences.kjv: But I would have you know, that the head of every man is Christ; and the head of the woman is the man; and the head of Christ is God.

occurrences.bsb: The body is a unit, though it is composed of many parts. And although its parts are many, they all form one body. So it is with Christ.
occurrences.kjv: For as the body is one, and hath many members, and all the members of that one body, being many, are one body: so also is Christ.

occurrences.bsb: Now you are the body of Christ, and each of you is a member of it.
occurrences.kjv: Now ye are the body of Christ, and members in particular.

occurrences.bsb: For what I received I passed on to you as of first importance: that Christ died for our sins according to the Scriptures,
occurrences.kjv: For I delivered unto you first of all that which I also received, how that Christ died for our sins according to the scriptures;

occurrences.bsb: But if it is preached that Christ has been raised from the dead, how can some of you say that there is no resurrection of the dead?
occurrences.kjv: Now if Christ be preached that he rose from the dead, how say some among you that there is no resurrection of the dead?

occurrences.bsb: If there is no resurrection of the dead, then not even Christ has been raised.
occurrences.kjv: But if there be no resurrection of the dead, then is Christ not risen:

occurrences.bsb: And if Christ has not been raised, our preaching is worthless, and so is your faith.
occurrences.kjv: And if Christ be not risen, then is our preaching vain, and your faith is also vain.

occurrences.bsb: In that case, we are also exposed as false witnesses about God. For we have testified about God that He raised Christ from the dead, but He did not raise Him if in fact the dead are not raised.
occurrences.kjv: Yea, and we are found false witnesses of God; because we have testified of God that he raised up Christ: whom he raised not up, if so be that the dead rise not.

occurrences.bsb: For if the dead are not raised, then not even Christ has been raised.
occurrences.kjv: For if the dead rise not, then is not Christ raised:

occurrences.bsb: And if Christ has not been raised, your faith is futile; you are still in your sins.
occurrences.kjv: And if Christ be not raised, your faith is vain; ye are yet in your sins.

occurrences.bsb: Then those also who have fallen asleep in Christ have perished.
occurrences.kjv: Then they also which are fallen asleep in Christ are perished.

occurrences.bsb: If our hope in Christ is for this life alone, we are to be pitied more than all men.
occurrences.kjv: If in this life only we have hope in Christ, we are of all men most miserable.

occurrences.bsb: But Christ has indeed been raised from the dead, the firstfruits of those who have fallen asleep.
occurrences.kjv: But now is Christ risen from the dead, and become the firstfruits of them that slept.

occurrences.bsb: For as in Adam all die, so in Christ all will be made alive.
occurrences.kjv: For as in Adam all die, even so in Christ shall all be made alive.

occurrences.bsb: But each in his own turn: Christ the firstfruits; then at His coming, those who belong to Him.
occurrences.kjv: But every man in his own order: Christ the firstfruits; afterward they that are Christ’s at his coming.

occurrences.bsb: I face death every day, brothers, as surely as I boast about you in Christ Jesus our Lord.
occurrences.kjv: I protest by your rejoicing which I have in Christ Jesus our Lord, I die daily.

occurrences.bsb: But thanks be to God, who gives us the victory through our Lord Jesus Christ!
occurrences.kjv: But thanks be to God, which giveth us the victory through our Lord Jesus Christ.

occurrences.bsb: My love be with all of you in Christ Jesus. Amen.
occurrences.kjv: My love be with you all in Christ Jesus. Amen. The first epistle to the Corinthians was written from Philippi by Stephanas, and Fortunatus, and Achaicus, and Timotheus.

occurrences.bsb: Paul, an apostle of Christ Jesus by the will of God, and Timothy our brother, To the church of God in Corinth, together with all the saints throughout Achaia:
occurrences.kjv: Paul, an apostle of Jesus Christ by the will of God, and Timothy our brother, unto the church of God which is at Corinth, with all the saints which are in all Achaia:

occurrences.bsb: Grace and peace to you from God our Father and the Lord Jesus Christ.
occurrences.kjv: Grace be to you and peace from God our Father, and from the Lord Jesus Christ.

occurrences.bsb: Blessed be the God and Father of our Lord Jesus Christ, the Father of compassion and the God of all comfort,
occurrences.kjv: Blessed be God, even the Father of our Lord Jesus Christ, the Father of mercies, and the God of all comfort;

occurrences.bsb: For just as the sufferings of Christ overflow to us, so also through Christ our comfort overflows.
occurrences.kjv: For as the sufferings of Christ abound in us, so our consolation also aboundeth by Christ.

occurrences.bsb: For the Son of God, Jesus Christ, who was proclaimed among you by me and Silvanus and Timothy, was not “Yes” and “No,” but in Him it has always been “Yes.”
occurrences.kjv: For the Son of God, Jesus Christ, who was preached among you by us, even by me and Silvanus and Timotheus, was not yea and nay, but in him was yea.

occurrences.bsb: Now it is God who establishes both us and you in Christ. He anointed us,
occurrences.kjv: Now he which stablisheth us with you in Christ, and hath anointed us, is God;

occurrences.bsb: If you forgive anyone, I also forgive him. And if I have forgiven anything, I have forgiven it in the presence of Christ for your sake,
occurrences.kjv: To whom ye forgive any thing, I forgive also: for if I forgave any thing, to whom I forgave it, for your sakes forgave I it in the person of Christ;

occurrences.bsb: Now when I went to Troas to preach the gospel of Christ and a door stood open for me in the Lord,
occurrences.kjv: Furthermore, when I came to Troas to preach Christ’s gospel, and a door was opened unto me of the Lord,

occurrences.bsb: But thanks be to God, who always leads us triumphantly as captives in Christ and through us spreads everywhere the fragrance of the knowledge of Him.
occurrences.kjv: Now thanks be unto God, which always causeth us to triumph in Christ, and maketh manifest the savour of his knowledge by us in every place.

occurrences.bsb: For we are to God the sweet aroma of Christ among those who are being saved and those who are perishing.
occurrences.kjv: For we are unto God a sweet savour of Christ, in them that are saved, and in them that perish:

occurrences.bsb: For we are not like so many others, who peddle the word of God for profit. On the contrary, in Christ we speak before God with sincerity, as men sent from God.
occurrences.kjv: For we are not as many, which corrupt the word of God: but as of sincerity, but as of God, in the sight of God speak we in Christ.

occurrences.bsb: It is clear that you are a letter from Christ, the result of our ministry, written not with ink but with the Spirit of the living God, not on tablets of stone but on tablets of human hearts.
occurrences.kjv: Forasmuch as ye are manifestly declared to be the epistle of Christ ministered by us, written not with ink, but with the Spirit of the living God; not in tables of stone, but in fleshy tables of the heart.

occurrences.bsb: Such confidence before God is ours through Christ.
occurrences.kjv: And such trust have we through Christ to God-ward:

occurrences.bsb: But their minds were closed. For to this day the same veil remains at the reading of the old covenant. It has not been lifted, because only in Christ can it be removed.
occurrences.kjv: But their minds were blinded: for until this day remaineth the same vail untaken away in the reading of the old testament; which vail is done away in Christ.

occurrences.bsb: The god of this age has blinded the minds of unbelievers, so they cannot see the light of the gospel of the glory of Christ, who is the image of God.
occurrences.kjv: In whom the god of this world hath blinded the minds of them which believe not, lest the light of the glorious gospel of Christ, who is the image of God, should shine unto them.

occurrences.bsb: For we do not proclaim ourselves, but Jesus Christ as Lord, and ourselves as your servants for Jesus’ sake.
occurrences.kjv: For we preach not ourselves, but Christ Jesus the Lord; and ourselves your servants for Jesus’ sake.

occurrences.bsb: For God, who said, “Let light shine out of darkness,” made His light shine in our hearts to give us the light of the knowledge of the glory of God in the face of Jesus Christ.
occurrences.kjv: For God, who commanded the light to shine out of darkness, hath shined in our hearts, to give the light of the knowledge of the glory of God in the face of Jesus Christ.

occurrences.bsb: For we must all appear before the judgment seat of Christ, that each one may receive his due for the things done in the body, whether good or bad.
occurrences.kjv: For we must all appear before the judgment seat of Christ; that every one may receive the things done in his body, according to that he hath done, whether it be good or bad.

occurrences.bsb: For Christ’s love compels us, because we are convinced that One died for all, therefore all died.
occurrences.kjv: For the love of Christ constraineth us; because we thus judge, that if one died for all, then were all dead:

occurrences.bsb: So from now on we regard no one according to the flesh. Although we once regarded Christ in this way, we do so no longer.
occurrences.kjv: Wherefore henceforth know we no man after the flesh: yea, though we have known Christ after the flesh, yet now henceforth know we him no more.

occurrences.bsb: Therefore if anyone is in Christ, he is a new creation. The old has passed away. Behold, the new has come!
occurrences.kjv: Therefore if any man be in Christ, he is a new creature: old things are passed away; behold, all things are become new.

occurrences.bsb: All this is from God, who reconciled us to Himself through Christ and gave us the ministry of reconciliation:
occurrences.kjv: And all things are of God, who hath reconciled us to himself by Jesus Christ, and hath given to us the ministry of reconciliation;

occurrences.bsb: that God was reconciling the world to Himself in Christ, not counting men’s trespasses against them. And He has committed to us the message of reconciliation.
occurrences.kjv: To wit, that God was in Christ, reconciling the world unto himself, not imputing their trespasses unto them; and hath committed unto us the word of reconciliation.

occurrences.bsb: Therefore we are ambassadors for Christ, as though God were making His appeal through us. We implore you on behalf of Christ: Be reconciled to God.
occurrences.kjv: Now then we are ambassadors for Christ, as though God did beseech you by us: we pray you in Christ’s stead, be ye reconciled to God.

occurrences.bsb: What harmony is there between Christ and Belial? Or what does a believer have in common with an unbeliever?
occurrences.kjv: And what concord hath Christ with Belial? or what part hath he that believeth with an infidel?

occurrences.bsb: For you know the grace of our Lord Jesus Christ, that though He was rich, yet for your sake He became poor, so that you through His poverty might become rich.
occurrences.kjv: For ye know the grace of our Lord Jesus Christ, that, though he was rich, yet for your sakes he became poor, that ye through his poverty might be rich.

occurrences.bsb: As for Titus, he is my partner and fellow worker among you. As for our brothers, they are messengers of the churches, the glory of Christ.
occurrences.kjv: Whether any do enquire of Titus, he is my partner and fellowhelper concerning you: or our brethren be enquired of, they are the messengers of the churches, and the glory of Christ.

occurrences.bsb: Because of the proof this ministry provides, the saints will glorify God for your obedient confession of the gospel of Christ, and for the generosity of your contribution to them and to all the others.
occurrences.kjv: Whiles by the experiment of this ministration they glorify God for your professed subjection unto the gospel of Christ, and for your liberal distribution unto them, and unto all men;

occurrences.bsb: Now by the mildness and gentleness of Christ, I appeal to you—I, Paul, who am humble when face to face with you, but bold when away.
occurrences.kjv: Now I Paul myself beseech you by the meekness and gentleness of Christ, who in presence am base among you, but being absent am bold toward you:

occurrences.bsb: We demolish arguments and every presumption set up against the knowledge of God; and we take captive every thought to make it obedient to Christ.
occurrences.kjv: Casting down imaginations, and every high thing that exalteth itself against the knowledge of God, and bringing into captivity every thought to the obedience of Christ;

occurrences.bsb: You are looking at outward appearances. If anyone is confident that he belongs to Christ, he should remind himself that we belong to Christ just as much as he does.
occurrences.kjv: Do ye look on things after the outward appearance? If any man trust to himself that he is Christ’s, let him of himself think this again, that, as he is Christ’s, even so are we Christ’s.

occurrences.bsb: We are not overstepping our bounds, as if we had not come to you. Indeed, we were the first to reach you with the gospel of Christ.
occurrences.kjv: For we stretch not ourselves beyond our measure, as though we reached not unto you: for we are come as far as to you also in preaching the gospel of Christ:

occurrences.bsb: I am jealous for you with a godly jealousy. For I promised you to one husband, to present you as a pure virgin to Christ.
occurrences.kjv: For I am jealous over you with godly jealousy: for I have espoused you to one husband, that I may present you as a chaste virgin to Christ.

occurrences.bsb: I am afraid, however, that just as Eve was deceived by the serpent’s cunning, your minds may be led astray from your simple and pure devotion to Christ.
occurrences.kjv: But I fear, lest by any means, as the serpent beguiled Eve through his subtilty, so your minds should be corrupted from the simplicity that is in Christ.

occurrences.bsb: As surely as the truth of Christ is in me, this boasting of mine will not be silenced in the regions of Achaia.
occurrences.kjv: As the truth of Christ is in me, no man shall stop me of this boasting in the regions of Achaia.

occurrences.bsb: For such men are false apostles, deceitful workers, masquerading as apostles of Christ.
occurrences.kjv: For such are false apostles, deceitful workers, transforming themselves into the apostles of Christ.

occurrences.bsb: Are they servants of Christ? (I am speaking as if I were out of my mind.) I am so much more: in harder labor, in more imprisonments, in worse beatings, in frequent danger of death.
occurrences.kjv: Are they ministers of Christ? (I speak as a fool) I am more; in labours more abundant, in stripes above measure, in prisons more frequent, in deaths oft.

occurrences.bsb: I know a man in Christ who fourteen years ago was caught up to the third heaven. Whether it was in the body or out of it I do not know, but God knows.
occurrences.kjv: I knew a man in Christ above fourteen years ago, (whether in the body, I cannot tell; or whether out of the body, I cannot tell: God knoweth;) such an one caught up to the third heaven.

occurrences.bsb: But He said to me, “My grace is sufficient for you, for My power is perfected in weakness.” Therefore I will boast all the more gladly in my weaknesses, so that the power of Christ may rest on me.
occurrences.kjv: And he said unto me, My grace is sufficient for thee: for my strength is made perfect in weakness. Most gladly therefore will I rather glory in my infirmities, that the power of Christ may rest upon me.

occurrences.bsb: That is why, for the sake of Christ, I delight in weaknesses, in insults, in hardships, in persecutions, in difficulties. For when I am weak, then I am strong.
occurrences.kjv: Therefore I take pleasure in infirmities, in reproaches, in necessities, in persecutions, in distresses for Christ’s sake: for when I am weak, then am I strong.

occurrences.bsb: Have you been thinking all along that we were making a defense to you? We speak before God in Christ, and all of this, beloved, is to build you up.
occurrences.kjv: Again, think ye that we excuse ourselves unto you? we speak before God in Christ: but we do all things, dearly beloved, for your edifying.

occurrences.bsb: since you are demanding proof that Christ is speaking through me. He is not weak in dealing with you but is powerful among you.
occurrences.kjv: Since ye seek a proof of Christ speaking in me, which to you-ward is not weak, but is mighty in you.

occurrences.bsb: Examine yourselves to see whether you are in the faith; test yourselves. Do you not realize that Jesus Christ is in you—unless you fail the test?
occurrences.kjv: Examine yourselves, whether ye be in the faith; prove your own selves. Know ye not your own selves, how that Jesus Christ is in you, except ye be reprobates?

occurrences.bsb: All the saints send you greetings.
occurrences.kjv: All the saints salute you.

occurrences.bsb: Paul, an apostle—sent not from men nor by man, but by Jesus Christ and God the Father, who raised Him from the dead—
occurrences.kjv: Paul, an apostle, (not of men, neither by man, but by Jesus Christ, and God the Father, who raised him from the dead;)

occurrences.bsb: Grace and peace to you from God our Father and the Lord Jesus Christ,
occurrences.kjv: Grace be to you and peace from God the Father, and from our Lord Jesus Christ,

occurrences.bsb: I am amazed how quickly you are deserting the One who called you by the grace of Christ and are turning to a different gospel—
occurrences.kjv: I marvel that ye are so soon removed from him that called you into the grace of Christ unto another gospel:

occurrences.bsb: which is not even a gospel. Evidently some people are troubling you and trying to distort the gospel of Christ.
occurrences.kjv: Which is not another; but there be some that trouble you, and would pervert the gospel of Christ.

occurrences.bsb: Am I now seeking the approval of men, or of God? Or am I striving to please men? If I were still trying to please men, I would not be a servant of Christ.
occurrences.kjv: For do I now persuade men, or God? or do I seek to please men? for if I yet pleased men, I should not be the servant of Christ.

occurrences.bsb: I did not receive it from any man, nor was I taught it; rather, I received it by revelation from Jesus Christ.
occurrences.kjv: For I neither received it of man, neither was I taught it, but by the revelation of Jesus Christ.

occurrences.bsb: I was personally unknown, however, to the churches of Judea that are in Christ.
occurrences.kjv: And was unknown by face unto the churches of Judea which were in Christ:

occurrences.bsb: This issue arose because some false brothers had come in under false pretenses to spy on our freedom in Christ Jesus, in order to enslave us.
occurrences.kjv: And that because of false brethren unawares brought in, who came in privily to spy out our liberty which we have in Christ Jesus, that they might bring us into bondage:

occurrences.bsb: know that a man is not justified by works of the law, but by faith in Jesus Christ. So we, too, have believed in Christ Jesus, that we may be justified by faith in Christ and not by works of the law, because by works of the law no one will be justified.
occurrences.kjv: Knowing that a man is not justified by the works of the law, but by the faith of Jesus Christ, even we have believed in Jesus Christ, that we might be justified by the faith of Christ, and not by the works of the law: for by the works of the law shall no flesh be justified.

occurrences.bsb: But if, while we seek to be justified in Christ, we ourselves are found to be sinners, does that make Christ a minister of sin? Certainly not!
occurrences.kjv: But if, while we seek to be justified by Christ, we ourselves also are found sinners, is therefore Christ the minister of sin? God forbid.

occurrences.bsb: For through the law I died to the law so that I might live to God.
occurrences.kjv: For I through the law am dead to the law, that I might live unto God.

occurrences.bsb: I have been crucified with Christ, and I no longer live, but Christ lives in me. The life I live in the body, I live by faith in the Son of God, who loved me and gave Himself up for me.
occurrences.kjv: I am crucified with Christ: nevertheless I live; yet not I, but Christ liveth in me: and the life which I now live in the flesh I live by the faith of the Son of God, who loved me, and gave himself for me.

occurrences.bsb: I do not set aside the grace of God. For if righteousness comes through the law, then Christ died for nothing.
occurrences.kjv: I do not frustrate the grace of God: for if righteousness come by the law, then Christ is dead in vain.

occurrences.bsb: O foolish Galatians! Who has bewitched you? Before your very eyes Jesus Christ was clearly portrayed as crucified.
occurrences.kjv: O foolish Galatians, who hath bewitched you, that ye should not obey the truth, before whose eyes Jesus Christ hath been evidently set forth, crucified among you?

occurrences.bsb: Christ redeemed us from the curse of the law by becoming a curse for us. For it is written: “Cursed is everyone who is hung on a tree.”
occurrences.kjv: Christ hath redeemed us from the curse of the law, being made a curse for us: for it is written, Cursed is every one that hangeth on a tree:

occurrences.bsb: He redeemed us in order that the blessing promised to Abraham would come to the Gentiles in Christ Jesus, so that by faith we might receive the promise of the Spirit.
occurrences.kjv: That the blessing of Abraham might come on the Gentiles through Jesus Christ; that we might receive the promise of the Spirit through faith.

occurrences.bsb: The promises were spoken to Abraham and to his seed. The Scripture does not say, “and to seeds,” meaning many, but “and to your seed,” meaning One, who is Christ.
occurrences.kjv: Now to Abraham and his seed were the promises made. He saith not, And to seeds, as of many; but as of one, And to thy seed, which is Christ.

occurrences.bsb: But the Scripture pronounces all things confined by sin, so that by faith in Jesus Christ the promise might be given to those who believe.
occurrences.kjv: But the scripture hath concluded all under sin, that the promise by faith of Jesus Christ might be given to them that believe.

occurrences.bsb: So the law became our guardian to lead us to Christ, that we might be justified by faith.
occurrences.kjv: Wherefore the law was our schoolmaster to bring us unto Christ, that we might be justified by faith.

occurrences.bsb: You are all sons of God through faith in Christ Jesus.
occurrences.kjv: For ye are all the children of God by faith in Christ Jesus.

occurrences.bsb: For all of you who were baptized into Christ have clothed yourselves with Christ.
occurrences.kjv: For as many of you as have been baptized into Christ have put on Christ.

occurrences.bsb: There is neither Jew nor Greek, slave nor free, male nor female, for you are all one in Christ Jesus.
occurrences.kjv: There is neither Jew nor Greek, there is neither bond nor free, there is neither male nor female: for ye are all one in Christ Jesus.

occurrences.bsb: And if you belong to Christ, then you are Abraham’s seed and heirs according to the promise.
occurrences.kjv: And if ye be Christ’s, then are ye Abraham’s seed, and heirs according to the promise.

occurrences.bsb: And although my illness was a trial to you, you did not despise or reject me. Instead, you welcomed me as if I were an angel of God, as if I were Christ Jesus Himself.
occurrences.kjv: And my temptation which was in my flesh ye despised not, nor rejected; but received me as an angel of God, even as Christ Jesus.

occurrences.bsb: My children, for whom I am again in the pains of childbirth until Christ is formed in you,
occurrences.kjv: My little children, of whom I travail in birth again until Christ be formed in you,

occurrences.bsb: It is for freedom that Christ has set us free. Stand firm, then, and do not be encumbered once more by a yoke of slavery.
occurrences.kjv: Stand fast therefore in the liberty wherewith Christ hath made us free, and be not entangled again with the yoke of bondage.

occurrences.bsb: Take notice: I, Paul, tell you that if you let yourselves be circumcised, Christ will be of no value to you at all.
occurrences.kjv: Behold, I Paul say unto you, that if ye be circumcised, Christ shall profit you nothing.

occurrences.bsb: You who are trying to be justified by the law have been severed from Christ; you have fallen away from grace.
occurrences.kjv: Christ is become of no effect unto you, whosoever of you are justified by the law; ye are fallen from grace.

occurrences.bsb: For in Christ Jesus neither circumcision nor uncircumcision has any value. What matters is faith expressing itself through love.
occurrences.kjv: For in Jesus Christ neither circumcision availeth any thing, nor uncircumcision; but faith which worketh by love.

occurrences.bsb: Those who belong to Christ Jesus have crucified the flesh with its passions and desires.
occurrences.kjv: And they that are Christ’s have crucified the flesh with the affections and lusts.

occurrences.bsb: Carry one another’s burdens, and in this way you will fulfill the law of Christ.
occurrences.kjv: Bear ye one another’s burdens, and so fulfil the law of Christ.

occurrences.bsb: Those who want to make a good impression outwardly are trying to compel you to be circumcised. They only do this to avoid persecution for the cross of Christ.
occurrences.kjv: As many as desire to make a fair shew in the flesh, they constrain you to be circumcised; only lest they should suffer persecution for the cross of Christ.

occurrences.bsb: But as for me, may I never boast, except in the cross of our Lord Jesus Christ, through which the world has been crucified to me, and I to the world.
occurrences.kjv: But God forbid that I should glory, save in the cross of our Lord Jesus Christ, by whom the world is crucified unto me, and I unto the world.

occurrences.bsb: The grace of our Lord Jesus Christ be with your spirit, brothers. Amen.
occurrences.kjv: Brethren, the grace of our Lord Jesus Christ be with your spirit. Amen. Unto the Galatians written from Rome.

occurrences.bsb: Paul, an apostle of Christ Jesus by the will of God, To the saints in Ephesus, the faithful in Christ Jesus:
occurrences.kjv: Paul, an apostle of Jesus Christ by the will of God, to the saints which are at Ephesus, and to the faithful in Christ Jesus:

occurrences.bsb: Grace and peace to you from God our Father and the Lord Jesus Christ.
occurrences.kjv: Grace be to you, and peace, from God our Father, and from the Lord Jesus Christ.

occurrences.bsb: Blessed be the God and Father of our Lord Jesus Christ, who has blessed us in Christ with every spiritual blessing in the heavenly realms.
occurrences.kjv: Blessed be the God and Father of our Lord Jesus Christ, who hath blessed us with all spiritual blessings in heavenly places in Christ:

occurrences.bsb: He predestined us for adoption as His sons through Jesus Christ, according to the good pleasure of His will,
occurrences.kjv: Having predestinated us unto the adoption of children by Jesus Christ to himself, according to the good pleasure of his will,

occurrences.bsb: as a plan for the fullness of time, to bring all things in heaven and on earth together in Christ.
occurrences.kjv: That in the dispensation of the fulness of times he might gather together in one all things in Christ, both which are in heaven, and which are on earth; even in him:

occurrences.bsb: in order that we, who were the first to hope in Christ, would be for the praise of His glory.
occurrences.kjv: That we should be to the praise of his glory, who first trusted in Christ.

occurrences.bsb: that the God of our Lord Jesus Christ, the glorious Father, may give you a spirit of wisdom and revelation in your knowledge of Him.
occurrences.kjv: That the God of our Lord Jesus Christ, the Father of glory, may give unto you the spirit of wisdom and revelation in the knowledge of him:

occurrences.bsb: which He exerted in Christ when He raised Him from the dead and seated Him at His right hand in the heavenly realms,
occurrences.kjv: Which he wrought in Christ, when he raised him from the dead, and set him at his own right hand in the heavenly places,

occurrences.bsb: made us alive with Christ even when we were dead in our trespasses. It is by grace you have been saved!
occurrences.kjv: Even when we were dead in sins, hath quickened us together with Christ, (by grace ye are saved;)

occurrences.bsb: And God raised us up with Christ and seated us with Him in the heavenly realms in Christ Jesus,
occurrences.kjv: And hath raised us up together, and made us sit together in heavenly places in Christ Jesus:

occurrences.bsb: in order that in the coming ages He might display the surpassing riches of His grace, demonstrated by His kindness to us in Christ Jesus.
occurrences.kjv: That in the ages to come he might shew the exceeding riches of his grace in his kindness toward us through Christ Jesus.

occurrences.bsb: For we are God’s workmanship, created in Christ Jesus to do good works, which God prepared in advance as our way of life.
occurrences.kjv: For we are his workmanship, created in Christ Jesus unto good works, which God hath before ordained that we should walk in them.

occurrences.bsb: remember that at that time you were separate from Christ, alienated from the commonwealth of Israel, and strangers to the covenants of the promise, without hope and without God in the world.
occurrences.kjv: That at that time ye were without Christ, being aliens from the commonwealth of Israel, and strangers from the covenants of promise, having no hope, and without God in the world:

occurrences.bsb: But now in Christ Jesus you who once were far away have been brought near through the blood of Christ.
occurrences.kjv: But now in Christ Jesus ye who sometimes were far off are made nigh by the blood of Christ.

occurrences.bsb: built on the foundation of the apostles and prophets, with Christ Jesus Himself as the cornerstone.
occurrences.kjv: And are built upon the foundation of the apostles and prophets, Jesus Christ himself being the chief corner stone;

occurrences.bsb: For this reason I, Paul, the prisoner of Christ Jesus for the sake of you Gentiles...
occurrences.kjv: For this cause I Paul, the prisoner of Jesus Christ for you Gentiles,

occurrences.bsb: In reading this, then, you will be able to understand my insight into the mystery of Christ,
occurrences.kjv: Whereby, when ye read, ye may understand my knowledge in the mystery of Christ)

occurrences.bsb: This mystery is that through the gospel the Gentiles are fellow heirs, fellow members of the body, and fellow partakers of the promise in Christ Jesus.
occurrences.kjv: That the Gentiles should be fellowheirs, and of the same body, and partakers of his promise in Christ by the gospel:

occurrences.bsb: Though I am less than the least of all the saints, this grace was given me: to preach to the Gentiles the unsearchable riches of Christ,
occurrences.kjv: Unto me, who am less than the least of all saints, is this grace given, that I should preach among the Gentiles the unsearchable riches of Christ;

occurrences.bsb: according to the eternal purpose that He accomplished in Christ Jesus our Lord.
occurrences.kjv: According to the eternal purpose which he purposed in Christ Jesus our Lord:

occurrences.bsb: so that Christ may dwell in your hearts through faith. Then you, being rooted and grounded in love,
occurrences.kjv: That Christ may dwell in your hearts by faith; that ye, being rooted and grounded in love,

occurrences.bsb: of the love of Christ, and to know this love that surpasses knowledge, that you may be filled with all the fullness of God.
occurrences.kjv: And to know the love of Christ, which passeth knowledge, that ye might be filled with all the fulness of God.

occurrences.bsb: to Him be the glory in the church and in Christ Jesus throughout all generations, forever and ever. Amen.
occurrences.kjv: Unto him be glory in the church by Christ Jesus throughout all ages, world without end. Amen.

occurrences.bsb: Now to each one of us grace has been given according to the measure of the gift of Christ.
occurrences.kjv: But unto every one of us is given grace according to the measure of the gift of Christ.

occurrences.bsb: to equip the saints for works of ministry and to build up the body of Christ,
occurrences.kjv: For the perfecting of the saints, for the work of the ministry, for the edifying of the body of Christ:

occurrences.bsb: until we all reach unity in the faith and in the knowledge of the Son of God, as we mature to the full measure of the stature of Christ.
occurrences.kjv: Till we all come in the unity of the faith, and of the knowledge of the Son of God, unto a perfect man, unto the measure of the stature of the fulness of Christ:

occurrences.bsb: Instead, speaking the truth in love, we will in all things grow up into Christ Himself, who is the head.
occurrences.kjv: But speaking the truth in love, may grow up into him in all things, which is the head, even Christ:

occurrences.bsb: But this is not the way you came to know Christ.
occurrences.kjv: But ye have not so learned Christ;

occurrences.bsb: Be kind and tenderhearted to one another, forgiving each other just as in Christ God forgave you.
occurrences.kjv: And be ye kind one to another, tenderhearted, forgiving one another, even as God for Christ’s sake hath forgiven you.

occurrences.bsb: and walk in love, just as Christ loved us and gave Himself up for us as a fragrant sacrificial offering to God.
occurrences.kjv: And walk in love, as Christ also hath loved us, and hath given himself for us an offering and a sacrifice to God for a sweetsmelling savour.

occurrences.bsb: For of this you can be sure: No immoral, impure, or greedy person (that is, an idolater) has any inheritance in the kingdom of Christ and of God.
occurrences.kjv: For this ye know, that no whoremonger, nor unclean person, nor covetous man, who is an idolater, hath any inheritance in the kingdom of Christ and of God.

occurrences.bsb: So it is said: “Wake up, O sleeper, rise up from the dead, and Christ will shine on you.”
occurrences.kjv: Wherefore he saith, Awake thou that sleepest, and arise from the dead, and Christ shall give thee light.

occurrences.bsb: always giving thanks to God the Father for everything in the name of our Lord Jesus Christ.
occurrences.kjv: Giving thanks always for all things unto God and the Father in the name of our Lord Jesus Christ;

occurrences.bsb: Submit to one another out of reverence for Christ.
occurrences.kjv: Submitting yourselves one to another in the fear of God.

occurrences.bsb: For the husband is the head of the wife as Christ is the head of the church, His body, of which He is the Savior.
occurrences.kjv: For the husband is the head of the wife, even as Christ is the head of the church: and he is the saviour of the body.

occurrences.bsb: Now as the church submits to Christ, so also wives should submit to their husbands in everything.
occurrences.kjv: Therefore as the church is subject unto Christ, so let the wives be to their own husbands in every thing.

occurrences.bsb: Husbands, love your wives, just as Christ loved the church and gave Himself up for her
occurrences.kjv: Husbands, love your wives, even as Christ also loved the church, and gave himself for it;

occurrences.bsb: Indeed, no one ever hated his own body, but he nourishes and cherishes it, just as Christ does the church.
occurrences.kjv: For no man ever yet hated his own flesh; but nourisheth and cherisheth it, even as the Lord the church:

occurrences.bsb: This mystery is profound, but I am speaking about Christ and the church.
occurrences.kjv: This is a great mystery: but I speak concerning Christ and the church.

occurrences.bsb: Slaves, obey your earthly masters with respect and fear and sincerity of heart, just as you would obey Christ.
occurrences.kjv: Servants, be obedient to them that are your masters according to the flesh, with fear and trembling, in singleness of your heart, as unto Christ;

occurrences.bsb: And do this not only to please them while they are watching, but as servants of Christ, doing the will of God from your heart.
occurrences.kjv: Not with eyeservice, as menpleasers; but as the servants of Christ, doing the will of God from the heart;

occurrences.bsb: Peace to the brothers and love with faith from God the Father and the Lord Jesus Christ.
occurrences.kjv: Peace be to the brethren, and love with faith, from God the Father and the Lord Jesus Christ.

occurrences.bsb: Grace to all who love our Lord Jesus Christ with an undying love.
occurrences.kjv: Grace be with all them that love our Lord Jesus Christ in sincerity. Amen. Written from Rome unto the Ephesians by Tychicus.

occurrences.bsb: Paul and Timothy, servants of Christ Jesus, To all the saints in Christ Jesus at Philippi, together with the overseers and deacons:
occurrences.kjv: Paul and Timotheus, the servants of Jesus Christ, to all the saints in Christ Jesus which are at Philippi, with the bishops and deacons:

occurrences.bsb: Grace and peace to you from God our Father and the Lord Jesus Christ.
occurrences.kjv: Grace be unto you, and peace, from God our Father, and from the Lord Jesus Christ.

occurrences.bsb: being confident of this, that He who began a good work in you will carry it on to completion until the day of Christ Jesus.
occurrences.kjv: Being confident of this very thing, that he which hath begun a good work in you will perform it until the day of Jesus Christ:

occurrences.bsb: God is my witness how I long for all of you with the affection of Christ Jesus.
occurrences.kjv: For God is my record, how greatly I long after you all in the bowels of Jesus Christ.

occurrences.bsb: so that you may be able to test and prove what is best and may be pure and blameless for the day of Christ,
occurrences.kjv: That ye may approve things that are excellent; that ye may be sincere and without offence till the day of Christ;

occurrences.bsb: filled with the fruit of righteousness that comes through Jesus Christ, to the glory and praise of God.
occurrences.kjv: Being filled with the fruits of righteousness, which are by Jesus Christ, unto the glory and praise of God.

occurrences.bsb: As a result, it has become clear throughout the whole palace guard and to everyone else that I am in chains for Christ.
occurrences.kjv: So that my bonds in Christ are manifest in all the palace, and in all other places;

occurrences.bsb: It is true that some preach Christ out of envy and rivalry, but others out of goodwill.
occurrences.kjv: Some indeed preach Christ even of envy and strife; and some also of good will:

occurrences.bsb: The former, however, preach Christ out of selfish ambition, not sincerely, supposing that they can add to the distress of my chains.
occurrences.kjv: But the other of love, knowing that I am set for the defence of the gospel.

occurrences.bsb: What then is the issue? Just this: that in every way, whether by false motives or true, Christ is preached. And in this I rejoice. Yes, and I will continue to rejoice,
occurrences.kjv: What then? notwithstanding, every way, whether in pretence, or in truth, Christ is preached; and I therein do rejoice, yea, and will rejoice.

occurrences.bsb: because I know that through your prayers and the provision of the Spirit of Jesus Christ, my distress will turn out for my deliverance.
occurrences.kjv: For I know that this shall turn to my salvation through your prayer, and the supply of the Spirit of Jesus Christ,

occurrences.bsb: I eagerly expect and hope that I will in no way be ashamed, but will have complete boldness so that now as always Christ will be exalted in my body, whether by life or by death.
occurrences.kjv: According to my earnest expectation and my hope, that in nothing I shall be ashamed, but that with all boldness, as always, so now also Christ shall be magnified in my body, whether it be by life, or by death.

occurrences.bsb: For to me, to live is Christ, and to die is gain.
occurrences.kjv: For to me to live is Christ, and to die is gain.

occurrences.bsb: I am torn between the two. I desire to depart and be with Christ, which is far better indeed.
occurrences.kjv: For I am in a strait betwixt two, having a desire to depart, and to be with Christ; which is far better:

occurrences.bsb: so that through my coming to you again your exultation in Christ Jesus will resound on account of me.
occurrences.kjv: That your rejoicing may be more abundant in Jesus Christ for me by my coming to you again.

occurrences.bsb: Nevertheless, conduct yourselves in a manner worthy of the gospel of Christ. Then, whether I come and see you or only hear about you in my absence, I will know that you stand firm in one spirit, contending together as one for the faith of the gospel,
occurrences.kjv: Only let your conversation be as it becometh the gospel of Christ: that whether I come and see you, or else be absent, I may hear of your affairs, that ye stand fast in one spirit, with one mind striving together for the faith of the gospel;

occurrences.bsb: For it has been granted to you on behalf of Christ not only to believe in Him, but also to suffer for Him,
occurrences.kjv: For unto you it is given in the behalf of Christ, not only to believe on him, but also to suffer for his sake;

occurrences.bsb: Therefore if you have any encouragement in Christ, if any comfort from His love, if any fellowship with the Spirit, if any affection and compassion,
occurrences.kjv: If there be therefore any consolation in Christ, if any comfort of love, if any fellowship of the Spirit, if any bowels and mercies,

occurrences.bsb: Let this mind be in you which was also in Christ Jesus:
occurrences.kjv: Let this mind be in you, which was also in Christ Jesus:

occurrences.bsb: and every tongue confess that Jesus Christ is Lord, to the glory of God the Father.
occurrences.kjv: And that every tongue should confess that Jesus Christ is Lord, to the glory of God the Father.

occurrences.bsb: as you hold forth the word of life, in order that I may boast on the day of Christ that I did not run or labor in vain.
occurrences.kjv: Holding forth the word of life; that I may rejoice in the day of Christ, that I have not run in vain, neither laboured in vain.

occurrences.bsb: For all the others look after their own interests, not those of Jesus Christ.
occurrences.kjv: For all seek their own, not the things which are Jesus Christ’s.

occurrences.bsb: because he nearly died for the work of Christ, risking his life to make up for your deficit of service to me.
occurrences.kjv: Because for the work of Christ he was nigh unto death, not regarding his life, to supply your lack of service toward me.

occurrences.bsb: For it is we who are the circumcision, we who worship by the Spirit of God, who glory in Christ Jesus, and who put no confidence in the flesh—
occurrences.kjv: For we are the circumcision, which worship God in the spirit, and rejoice in Christ Jesus, and have no confidence in the flesh.

occurrences.bsb: But whatever was gain to me I count as loss for the sake of Christ.
occurrences.kjv: But what things were gain to me, those I counted loss for Christ.

occurrences.bsb: More than that, I count all things as loss compared to the surpassing excellence of knowing Christ Jesus my Lord, for whom I have lost all things. I consider them rubbish, that I may gain Christ
occurrences.kjv: Yea doubtless, and I count all things but loss for the excellency of the knowledge of Christ Jesus my Lord: for whom I have suffered the loss of all things, and do count them but dung, that I may win Christ,

occurrences.bsb: and be found in Him, not having my own righteousness from the law, but that which is through faith in Christ, the righteousness from God on the basis of faith.
occurrences.kjv: And be found in him, not having mine own righteousness, which is of the law, but that which is through the faith of Christ, the righteousness which is of God by faith:

occurrences.bsb: Not that I have already obtained all this, or have already been made perfect, but I press on to take hold of that for which Christ Jesus took hold of me.
occurrences.kjv: Not as though I had already attained, either were already perfect: but I follow after, if that I may apprehend that for which also I am apprehended of Christ Jesus.

occurrences.bsb: I press on toward the goal to win the prize of God’s heavenly calling in Christ Jesus.
occurrences.kjv: I press toward the mark for the prize of the high calling of God in Christ Jesus.

occurrences.bsb: For as I have often told you before, and now say again even with tears: Many live as enemies of the cross of Christ.
occurrences.kjv: (For many walk, of whom I have told you often, and now tell you even weeping, that they are the enemies of the cross of Christ:

occurrences.bsb: But our citizenship is in heaven, and we eagerly await a Savior from there, the Lord Jesus Christ,
occurrences.kjv: For our conversation is in heaven; from whence also we look for the Saviour, the Lord Jesus Christ:

occurrences.bsb: And the peace of God, which surpasses all understanding, will guard your hearts and your minds in Christ Jesus.
occurrences.kjv: And the peace of God, which passeth all understanding, shall keep your hearts and minds through Christ Jesus.

occurrences.bsb: And my God will supply all your needs according to His glorious riches in Christ Jesus.
occurrences.kjv: But my God shall supply all your need according to his riches in glory by Christ Jesus.

occurrences.bsb: Greet all the saints in Christ Jesus. The brothers who are with me send you greetings.
occurrences.kjv: Salute every saint in Christ Jesus. The brethren which are with me greet you.

occurrences.bsb: The grace of the Lord Jesus Christ be with your spirit.
occurrences.kjv: The grace of our Lord Jesus Christ be with you all. Amen. It was written to the Philippians from Rome by Epaphroditus.

occurrences.bsb: Paul, an apostle of Christ Jesus by the will of God, and Timothy our brother,
occurrences.kjv: Paul, an apostle of Jesus Christ by the will of God, and Timotheus our brother,

occurrences.bsb: To the saints and faithful brothers in Christ at Colossae: Grace and peace to you from God our Father.
occurrences.kjv: To the saints and faithful brethren in Christ which are at Colosse: Grace be unto you, and peace, from God our Father and the Lord Jesus Christ.

occurrences.bsb: We always thank God, the Father of our Lord Jesus Christ, when we pray for you,
occurrences.kjv: We give thanks to God and the Father of our Lord Jesus Christ, praying always for you,

occurrences.bsb: because we have heard about your faith in Christ Jesus and your love for all the saints—
occurrences.kjv: Since we heard of your faith in Christ Jesus, and of the love which ye have to all the saints,

occurrences.bsb: You learned it from Epaphras, our beloved fellow servant, who is a faithful minister of Christ on our behalf,
occurrences.kjv: As ye also learned of Epaphras our dear fellowservant, who is for you a faithful minister of Christ;

occurrences.bsb: Now I rejoice in my sufferings for you, and I fill up in my flesh what is lacking in regard to Christ’s afflictions for the sake of His body, which is the church.
occurrences.kjv: Who now rejoice in my sufferings for you, and fill up that which is behind of the afflictions of Christ in my flesh for his body’s sake, which is the church:

occurrences.bsb: To them God has chosen to make known among the Gentiles the glorious riches of this mystery, which is Christ in you, the hope of glory.
occurrences.kjv: To whom God would make known what is the riches of the glory of this mystery among the Gentiles; which is Christ in you, the hope of glory:

occurrences.bsb: We proclaim Him, admonishing and teaching everyone with all wisdom, so that we may present everyone perfect in Christ.
occurrences.kjv: Whom we preach, warning every man, and teaching every man in all wisdom; that we may present every man perfect in Christ Jesus:

occurrences.bsb: that they may be encouraged in heart, knit together in love, and filled with the full riches of complete understanding, so that they may know the mystery of God, namely Christ,
occurrences.kjv: That their hearts might be comforted, being knit together in love, and unto all riches of the full assurance of understanding, to the acknowledgement of the mystery of God, and of the Father, and of Christ;

occurrences.bsb: For although I am absent from you in body, I am present with you in spirit, and I delight to see your orderly condition and firm faith in Christ.
occurrences.kjv: For though I be absent in the flesh, yet am I with you in the spirit, joying and beholding your order, and the stedfastness of your faith in Christ.

occurrences.bsb: Therefore, just as you have received Christ Jesus as Lord, continue to walk in Him,
occurrences.kjv: As ye have therefore received Christ Jesus the Lord, so walk ye in him:

occurrences.bsb: See to it that no one takes you captive through philosophy and empty deception, which are based on human tradition and the spiritual forces of the world rather than on Christ.
occurrences.kjv: Beware lest any man spoil you through philosophy and vain deceit, after the tradition of men, after the rudiments of the world, and not after Christ.

occurrences.bsb: In Him you were also circumcised, in the putting off of your sinful nature, with the circumcision performed by Christ and not by human hands.
occurrences.kjv: In whom also ye are circumcised with the circumcision made without hands, in putting off the body of the sins of the flesh by the circumcision of Christ:

occurrences.bsb: These are a shadow of the things to come, but the body that casts it belongs to Christ.
occurrences.kjv: Which are a shadow of things to come; but the body is of Christ.

occurrences.bsb: If you have died with Christ to the spiritual forces of the world, why, as though you still belonged to the world, do you submit to its regulations:
occurrences.kjv: Wherefore if ye be dead with Christ from the rudiments of the world, why, as though living in the world, are ye subject to ordinances,

occurrences.bsb: Therefore, since you have been raised with Christ, strive for the things above, where Christ is seated at the right hand of God.
occurrences.kjv: If ye then be risen with Christ, seek those things which are above, where Christ sitteth on the right hand of God.

occurrences.bsb: For you died, and your life is now hidden with Christ in God.
occurrences.kjv: For ye are dead, and your life is hid with Christ in God.

occurrences.bsb: When Christ, who is your life, appears, then you also will appear with Him in glory.
occurrences.kjv: When Christ, who is our life, shall appear, then shall ye also appear with him in glory.

occurrences.bsb: Here there is no Greek or Jew, circumcised or uncircumcised, barbarian, Scythian, slave, or free, but Christ is all and is in all.
occurrences.kjv: Where there is neither Greek nor Jew, circumcision nor uncircumcision, Barbarian, Scythian, bond nor free: but Christ is all, and in all.

occurrences.bsb: Let the peace of Christ rule in your hearts, for to this you were called as members of one body. And be thankful.
occurrences.kjv: And let the peace of God rule in your hearts, to the which also ye are called in one body; and be ye thankful.

occurrences.bsb: Let the word of Christ richly dwell within you as you teach and admonish one another with all wisdom, and as you sing psalms, hymns, and spiritual songs with gratitude in your hearts to God.
occurrences.kjv: Let the word of Christ dwell in you richly in all wisdom; teaching and admonishing one another in psalms and hymns and spiritual songs, singing with grace in your hearts to the Lord.

occurrences.bsb: because you know that you will receive an inheritance from the Lord as your reward. It is the Lord Christ you are serving.
occurrences.kjv: Knowing that of the Lord ye shall receive the reward of the inheritance: for ye serve the Lord Christ.

occurrences.bsb: as you pray also for us, that God may open to us a door for the word, so that we may proclaim the mystery of Christ, for which I am in chains.
occurrences.kjv: Withal praying also for us, that God would open unto us a door of utterance, to speak the mystery of Christ, for which I am also in bonds:

occurrences.bsb: Epaphras, who is one of you and a servant of Christ Jesus, sends you greetings. He is always wrestling in prayer for you, so that you may stand mature and fully assured in the full will of God.
occurrences.kjv: Epaphras, who is one of you, a servant of Christ, saluteth you, always labouring fervently for you in prayers, that ye may stand perfect and complete in all the will of God.

occurrences.bsb: Paul, Silvanus, and Timothy, To the church of the Thessalonians in God the Father and the Lord Jesus Christ: Grace and peace to you.
occurrences.kjv: Paul, and Silvanus, and Timotheus, unto the church of the Thessalonians which is in God the Father and in the Lord Jesus Christ: Grace be unto you, and peace, from God our Father, and the Lord Jesus Christ.

occurrences.bsb: and continually recalling before our God and Father your work of faith, your labor of love, and your enduring hope in our Lord Jesus Christ.
occurrences.kjv: Remembering without ceasing your work of faith, and labour of love, and patience of hope in our Lord Jesus Christ, in the sight of God and our Father;

occurrences.bsb: On the contrary, we were gentle among you, like a nursing mother caring for her children.
occurrences.kjv: But we were gentle among you, even as a nurse cherisheth her children:

occurrences.bsb: For you, brothers, became imitators of the churches of God in Judea that are in Christ Jesus. You suffered from your own countrymen the very things they suffered from the Jews,
occurrences.kjv: For ye, brethren, became followers of the churches of God which in Judea are in Christ Jesus: for ye also have suffered like things of your own countrymen, even as they have of the Jews:

occurrences.bsb: We sent Timothy, our brother and fellow worker for God in the gospel of Christ, to strengthen and encourage you in your faith,
occurrences.kjv: And sent Timotheus, our brother, and minister of God, and our fellowlabourer in the gospel of Christ, to establish you, and to comfort you concerning your faith:

occurrences.bsb: For the Lord Himself will descend from heaven with a loud command, with the voice of an archangel, and with the trumpet of God, and the dead in Christ will be the first to rise.
occurrences.kjv: For the Lord himself shall descend from heaven with a shout, with the voice of the archangel, and with the trump of God: and the dead in Christ shall rise first:

occurrences.bsb: For God has not appointed us to suffer wrath, but to obtain salvation through our Lord Jesus Christ.
occurrences.kjv: For God hath not appointed us to wrath, but to obtain salvation by our Lord Jesus Christ,

occurrences.bsb: Give thanks in every circumstance, for this is God’s will for you in Christ Jesus.
occurrences.kjv: In every thing give thanks: for this is the will of God in Christ Jesus concerning you.

occurrences.bsb: Now may the God of peace Himself sanctify you completely, and may your entire spirit, soul, and body be kept blameless at the coming of our Lord Jesus Christ.
occurrences.kjv: And the very God of peace sanctify you wholly; and I pray God your whole spirit and soul and body be preserved blameless unto the coming of our Lord Jesus Christ.

occurrences.bsb: The grace of our Lord Jesus Christ be with you.
occurrences.kjv: The grace of our Lord Jesus Christ be with you. Amen. The first epistle unto the Thessalonians was written from Athens.

occurrences.bsb: Paul, Silvanus, and Timothy, To the church of the Thessalonians in God our Father and the Lord Jesus Christ:
occurrences.kjv: Paul, and Silvanus, and Timotheus, unto the church of the Thessalonians in God our Father and the Lord Jesus Christ:

occurrences.bsb: Grace and peace to you from God our Father and the Lord Jesus Christ.
occurrences.kjv: Grace unto you, and peace, from God our Father and the Lord Jesus Christ.

occurrences.bsb: so that the name of our Lord Jesus will be glorified in you, and you in Him, according to the grace of our God and of the Lord Jesus Christ.
occurrences.kjv: That the name of our Lord Jesus Christ may be glorified in you, and ye in him, according to the grace of our God and the Lord Jesus Christ.

occurrences.bsb: Now concerning the coming of our Lord Jesus Christ and our being gathered together to Him, we ask you, brothers,
occurrences.kjv: Now we beseech you, brethren, by the coming of our Lord Jesus Christ, and by our gathering together unto him,

occurrences.bsb: To this He called you through our gospel, so that you may share in the glory of our Lord Jesus Christ.
occurrences.kjv: Whereunto he called you by our gospel, to the obtaining of the glory of our Lord Jesus Christ.

occurrences.bsb: Now may our Lord Jesus Christ Himself and God our Father, who by grace has loved us and given us eternal comfort and good hope,
occurrences.kjv: Now our Lord Jesus Christ himself, and God, even our Father, which hath loved us, and hath given us everlasting consolation and good hope through grace,

occurrences.bsb: May the Lord direct your hearts into God’s love and Christ’s perseverance.
occurrences.kjv: And the Lord direct your hearts into the love of God, and into the patient waiting for Christ.

occurrences.bsb: Now we command you, brothers, in the name of our Lord Jesus Christ, to keep away from any brother who leads an undisciplined life that is not in keeping with the tradition you received from us.
occurrences.kjv: Now we command you, brethren, in the name of our Lord Jesus Christ, that ye withdraw yourselves from every brother that walketh disorderly, and not after the tradition which he received of us.

occurrences.bsb: We command and urge such people by our Lord Jesus Christ to begin working quietly to earn their own living.
occurrences.kjv: Now them that are such we command and exhort by our Lord Jesus Christ, that with quietness they work, and eat their own bread.

occurrences.bsb: The grace of our Lord Jesus Christ be with all of you.
occurrences.kjv: The grace of our Lord Jesus Christ be with you all. Amen. The second epistle to the Thessalonians was written from Athens.

occurrences.bsb: Paul, an apostle of Christ Jesus by the command of God our Savior and of Christ Jesus our hope,
occurrences.kjv: Paul, an apostle of Jesus Christ by the commandment of God our Saviour, and Lord Jesus Christ, which is our hope;

occurrences.bsb: To Timothy, my true child in the faith: Grace, mercy, and peace from God the Father and Christ Jesus our Lord.
occurrences.kjv: Unto Timothy, my own son in the faith: Grace, mercy, and peace, from God our Father and Jesus Christ our Lord.

occurrences.bsb: I thank Christ Jesus our Lord, who has strengthened me, that He considered me faithful and appointed me to service.
occurrences.kjv: And I thank Christ Jesus our Lord, who hath enabled me, for that he counted me faithful, putting me into the ministry;

occurrences.bsb: And the grace of our Lord overflowed to me, along with the faith and love that are in Christ Jesus.
occurrences.kjv: And the grace of our Lord was exceeding abundant with faith and love which is in Christ Jesus.
