occurrences.bsb: This is a trustworthy saying, worthy of full acceptance: Christ Jesus came into the world to save sinners, of whom I am the worst.
occurrences.kjv: This is a faithful saying, and worthy of all acceptation, that Christ Jesus came into the world to save sinners; of whom I am chief.

occurrences.bsb: But for this very reason I was shown mercy, so that in me, the worst of sinners, Christ Jesus might display His perfect patience as an example to those who would believe in Him for eternal life.
occurrences.kjv: Howbeit for this cause I obtained mercy, that in me first Jesus Christ might shew forth all longsuffering, for a pattern to them which should hereafter believe on him to life everlasting.

occurrences.bsb: For there is one God, and there is one mediator between God and men, the man Christ Jesus,
occurrences.kjv: For there is one God, and one mediator between God and men, the man Christ Jesus;

occurrences.bsb: For those who have served well as deacons acquire for themselves a high standing and great confidence in the faith that is in Christ Jesus.
occurrences.kjv: For they that have used the office of a deacon well purchase to themselves a good degree, and great boldness in the faith which is in Christ Jesus.

occurrences.bsb: By pointing out these things to the brothers, you will be a good servant of Christ Jesus, nourished by the words of faith and sound instruction that you have followed.
occurrences.kjv: If thou put the brethren in remembrance of these things, thou shalt be a good minister of Jesus Christ, nourished up in the words of faith and of good doctrine, whereunto thou hast attained.

occurrences.bsb: But refuse to enroll younger widows. For when their passions draw them away from Christ, they will want to marry,
occurrences.kjv: But the younger widows refuse: for when they have begun to wax wanton against Christ, they will marry;

occurrences.bsb: I solemnly charge you before God and Christ Jesus and the elect angels to maintain these principles without bias, and to do nothing out of partiality.
occurrences.kjv: I charge thee before God, and the Lord Jesus Christ, and the elect angels, that thou observe these things without preferring one before another, doing nothing by partiality.

occurrences.bsb: If anyone teaches another doctrine and disagrees with the sound words of our Lord Jesus Christ and with godly teaching,
occurrences.kjv: If any man teach otherwise, and consent not to wholesome words, even the words of our Lord Jesus Christ, and to the doctrine which is according to godliness;

occurrences.bsb: I charge you in the presence of God, who gives life to all things, and of Christ Jesus, who made the good confession in His testimony before Pontius Pilate:
occurrences.kjv: I give thee charge in the sight of God, who quickeneth all things, and before Christ Jesus, who before Pontius Pilate witnessed a good confession;

occurrences.bsb: Keep this commandment without stain or reproach until the appearance of our Lord Jesus Christ,
occurrences.kjv: That thou keep this commandment without spot, unrebukeable, until the appearing of our Lord Jesus Christ:

occurrences.bsb: Paul, an apostle of Christ Jesus by the will of God, according to the promise of life in Christ Jesus,
occurrences.kjv: Paul, an apostle of Jesus Christ by the will of God, according to the promise of life which is in Christ Jesus,

occurrences.bsb: To Timothy, my beloved child: Grace, mercy, and peace from God the Father and Christ Jesus our Lord.
occurrences.kjv: To Timothy, my dearly beloved son: Grace, mercy, and peace, from God the Father and Christ Jesus our Lord.

occurrences.bsb: He has saved us and called us to a holy calling, not because of our works, but by His own purpose and by the grace He granted us in Christ Jesus before time began.
occurrences.kjv: Who hath saved us, and called us with an holy calling, not according to our works, but according to his own purpose and grace, which was given us in Christ Jesus before the world began,

occurrences.bsb: And now He has revealed this grace through the appearing of our Savior, Christ Jesus, who has abolished death and illuminated the way to life and immortality through the gospel,
occurrences.kjv: But is now made manifest by the appearing of our Saviour Jesus Christ, who hath abolished death, and hath brought life and immortality to light through the gospel:

occurrences.bsb: Hold on to the pattern of sound teaching you have heard from me, with the faith and love that are in Christ Jesus.
occurrences.kjv: Hold fast the form of sound words, which thou hast heard of me, in faith and love which is in Christ Jesus.

occurrences.bsb: You therefore, my child, be strong in the grace that is in Christ Jesus.
occurrences.kjv: Thou therefore, my son, be strong in the grace that is in Christ Jesus.

occurrences.bsb: Join me in suffering, like a good soldier of Christ Jesus.
occurrences.kjv: Thou therefore endure hardness, as a good soldier of Jesus Christ.

occurrences.bsb: Remember Jesus Christ, raised from the dead, descended from David, as proclaimed by my gospel,
occurrences.kjv: Remember that Jesus Christ of the seed of David was raised from the dead according to my gospel:

occurrences.bsb: For this reason I endure all things for the sake of the elect, so that they too may obtain the salvation that is in Christ Jesus, with eternal glory.
occurrences.kjv: Therefore I endure all things for the elect’s sakes, that they may also obtain the salvation which is in Christ Jesus with eternal glory.

occurrences.bsb: Indeed, all who desire to live godly lives in Christ Jesus will be persecuted,
occurrences.kjv: Yea, and all that will live godly in Christ Jesus shall suffer persecution.

occurrences.bsb: From infancy you have known the Holy Scriptures, which are able to make you wise for salvation through faith in Christ Jesus.
occurrences.kjv: And that from a child thou hast known the holy scriptures, which are able to make thee wise unto salvation through faith which is in Christ Jesus.

occurrences.bsb: I charge you in the presence of God and of Christ Jesus, who will judge the living and the dead, and in view of His appearing and His kingdom:
occurrences.kjv: I charge thee therefore before God, and the Lord Jesus Christ, who shall judge the quick and the dead at his appearing and his kingdom;

occurrences.bsb: Paul, a servant of God and an apostle of Jesus Christ for the faith of God’s elect and their knowledge of the truth that leads to godliness,
occurrences.kjv: Paul, a servant of God, and an apostle of Jesus Christ, according to the faith of God’s elect, and the acknowledging of the truth which is after godliness;

occurrences.bsb: To Titus, my true child in our common faith: Grace and peace from God the Father and Christ Jesus our Savior.
occurrences.kjv: To Titus, mine own son after the common faith: Grace, mercy, and peace, from God the Father and the Lord Jesus Christ our Saviour.

occurrences.bsb: as we await the blessed hope and glorious appearance of our great God and Savior Jesus Christ.
occurrences.kjv: Looking for that blessed hope, and the glorious appearing of the great God and our Saviour Jesus Christ;

occurrences.bsb: This is the Spirit He poured out on us abundantly through Jesus Christ our Savior,
occurrences.kjv: Which he shed on us abundantly through Jesus Christ our Saviour;

occurrences.bsb: Paul, a prisoner of Christ Jesus, and Timothy our brother, To Philemon our beloved fellow worker,
occurrences.kjv: Paul, a prisoner of Jesus Christ, and Timothy our brother, unto Philemon our dearly beloved, and fellowlabourer,

occurrences.bsb: Grace and peace to you from God our Father and the Lord Jesus Christ.
occurrences.kjv: Grace to you, and peace, from God our Father and the Lord Jesus Christ.

occurrences.bsb: I pray that your partnership in the faith may become effective as you fully acknowledge every good thing that is ours in Christ.
occurrences.kjv: That the communication of thy faith may become effectual by the acknowledging of every good thing which is in you in Christ Jesus.

occurrences.bsb: So although in Christ I am bold enough to order you to do what is proper,
occurrences.kjv: Wherefore, though I might be much bold in Christ to enjoin thee that which is convenient,

occurrences.bsb: I prefer to appeal on the basis of love. For I, Paul, am now aged, and a prisoner of Christ Jesus as well.
occurrences.kjv: Yet for love’s sake I rather beseech thee, being such an one as Paul the aged, and now also a prisoner of Jesus Christ.

occurrences.bsb: Yes, brother, let me have some benefit from you in the Lord. Refresh my heart in Christ.
occurrences.kjv: Yea, brother, let me have joy of thee in the Lord: refresh my bowels in the Lord.

occurrences.bsb: Epaphras, my fellow prisoner in Christ Jesus, sends you greetings,
occurrences.kjv: There salute thee Epaphras, my fellowprisoner in Christ Jesus;

occurrences.bsb: The grace of the Lord Jesus Christ be with your spirit.
occurrences.kjv: The grace of our Lord Jesus Christ be with your spirit. Amen. Written from Rome to Philemon, by Onesimus a servant.

occurrences.bsb: But Christ is faithful as the Son over God’s house. And we are His house, if we hold firmly to our confidence and the hope of which we boast.
occurrences.kjv: But Christ as a son over his own house; whose house are we, if we hold fast the confidence and the rejoicing of the hope firm unto the end.

occurrences.bsb: We have come to share in Christ if we hold firmly to the end the assurance we had at first.
occurrences.kjv: For we are made partakers of Christ, if we hold the beginning of our confidence stedfast unto the end;

occurrences.bsb: So also Christ did not take upon Himself the glory of becoming a high priest, but He was called by the One who said to Him: “You are My Son; today I have become Your Father.”
occurrences.kjv: So also Christ glorified not himself to be made an high priest; but he that said unto him, Thou art my Son, to day have I begotten thee.

occurrences.bsb: Therefore let us leave the elementary teachings about Christ and go on to maturity, not laying again the foundation of repentance from dead works, and of faith in God,
occurrences.kjv: Therefore leaving the principles of the doctrine of Christ, let us go on unto perfection; not laying again the foundation of repentance from dead works, and of faith toward God,

occurrences.bsb: But when Christ came as high priest of the good things that have come, He went through the greater and more perfect tabernacle that is not made by hands and is not a part of this creation.
occurrences.kjv: But Christ being come an high priest of good things to come, by a greater and more perfect tabernacle, not made with hands, that is to say, not of this building;

occurrences.bsb: how much more will the blood of Christ, who through the eternal Spirit offered Himself unblemished to God, purify our consciences from works of death, so that we may serve the living God!
occurrences.kjv: How much more shall the blood of Christ, who through the eternal Spirit offered himself without spot to God, purge your conscience from dead works to serve the living God?

occurrences.bsb: For Christ did not enter a man-made copy of the true sanctuary, but He entered heaven itself, now to appear on our behalf in the presence of God.
occurrences.kjv: For Christ is not entered into the holy places made with hands, which are the figures of the true; but into heaven itself, now to appear in the presence of God for us:

occurrences.bsb: so also Christ was offered once to bear the sins of many; and He will appear a second time, not to bear sin, but to bring salvation to those who eagerly await Him.
occurrences.kjv: So Christ was once offered to bear the sins of many; and unto them that look for him shall he appear the second time without sin unto salvation.

occurrences.bsb: And by that will, we have been sanctified through the sacrifice of the body of Jesus Christ once for all.
occurrences.kjv: By the which will we are sanctified through the offering of the body of Jesus Christ once for all.

occurrences.bsb: He valued disgrace for Christ above the treasures of Egypt, for he was looking ahead to his reward.
occurrences.kjv: Esteeming the reproach of Christ greater riches than the treasures in Egypt: for he had respect unto the recompence of the reward.

occurrences.bsb: Jesus Christ is the same yesterday and today and forever.
occurrences.kjv: Jesus Christ the same yesterday, and to day, and for ever.

occurrences.bsb: equip you with every good thing to do His will. And may He accomplish in us what is pleasing in His sight through Jesus Christ, to whom be glory forever and ever. Amen.
occurrences.kjv: Make you perfect in every good work to do his will, working in you that which is wellpleasing in his sight, through Jesus Christ; to whom be glory for ever and ever. Amen.

occurrences.bsb: James, a servant of God and of the Lord Jesus Christ, To the twelve tribes of the Dispersion: Greetings.
occurrences.kjv: James, a servant of God and of the Lord Jesus Christ, to the twelve tribes which are scattered abroad, greeting.

occurrences.bsb: My brothers, as you hold out your faith in our glorious Lord Jesus Christ, do not show favoritism.
occurrences.kjv: My brethren, have not the faith of our Lord Jesus Christ, the Lord of glory, with respect of persons.

occurrences.bsb: Peter, an apostle of Jesus Christ, To the elect who are exiles of the Dispersion throughout Pontus, Galatia, Cappadocia, Asia, and Bithynia, chosen
occurrences.kjv: Peter, an apostle of Jesus Christ, to the strangers scattered throughout Pontus, Galatia, Cappadocia, Asia, and Bithynia,

occurrences.bsb: according to the foreknowledge of God the Father and sanctified by the Spirit for obedience to Jesus Christ and sprinkling by His blood: Grace and peace be yours in abundance.
occurrences.kjv: Elect according to the foreknowledge of God the Father, through sanctification of the Spirit, unto obedience and sprinkling of the blood of Jesus Christ: Grace unto you, and peace, be multiplied.

occurrences.bsb: Blessed be the God and Father of our Lord Jesus Christ! By His great mercy He has given us new birth into a living hope through the resurrection of Jesus Christ from the dead,
occurrences.kjv: Blessed be the God and Father of our Lord Jesus Christ, which according to his abundant mercy hath begotten us again unto a lively hope by the resurrection of Jesus Christ from the dead,

occurrences.bsb: so that the proven character of your faith—more precious than gold, which perishes even though refined by fire—may result in praise, glory, and honor at the revelation of Jesus Christ.
occurrences.kjv: That the trial of your faith, being much more precious than of gold that perisheth, though it be tried with fire, might be found unto praise and honour and glory at the appearing of Jesus Christ:

occurrences.bsb: trying to determine the time and setting to which the Spirit of Christ in them was pointing when He predicted the sufferings of Christ and the glories to follow.
occurrences.kjv: Searching what, or what manner of time the Spirit of Christ which was in them did signify, when it testified beforehand the sufferings of Christ, and the glory that should follow.

occurrences.bsb: Therefore prepare your minds for action. Be sober-minded. Set your hope fully on the grace to be given you at the revelation of Jesus Christ.
occurrences.kjv: Wherefore gird up the loins of your mind, be sober, and hope to the end for the grace that is to be brought unto you at the revelation of Jesus Christ;

occurrences.bsb: but with the precious blood of Christ, a lamb without blemish or spot.
occurrences.kjv: But with the precious blood of Christ, as of a lamb without blemish and without spot:

occurrences.bsb: you also, like living stones, are being built into a spiritual house to be a holy priesthood, offering spiritual sacrifices acceptable to God through Jesus Christ.
occurrences.kjv: Ye also, as lively stones, are built up a spiritual house, an holy priesthood, to offer up spiritual sacrifices, acceptable to God by Jesus Christ.

occurrences.bsb: For to this you were called, because Christ also suffered for you, leaving you an example, that you should follow in His footsteps:
occurrences.kjv: For even hereunto were ye called: because Christ also suffered for us, leaving us an example, that ye should follow his steps:

occurrences.bsb: But in your hearts sanctify Christ as Lord. Always be prepared to give a defense to everyone who asks you the reason for the hope that is in you. But respond with gentleness and respect,
occurrences.kjv: But sanctify the Lord God in your hearts: and be ready always to give an answer to every man that asketh you a reason of the hope that is in you with meekness and fear:

occurrences.bsb: keeping a clear conscience, so that those who slander you may be put to shame by your good behavior in Christ.
occurrences.kjv: Having a good conscience; that, whereas they speak evil of you, as of evildoers, they may be ashamed that falsely accuse your good conversation in Christ.

occurrences.bsb: For Christ also suffered for sins once for all, the righteous for the unrighteous, to bring you to God. He was put to death in the body but made alive in the Spirit,
occurrences.kjv: For Christ also hath once suffered for sins, the just for the unjust, that he might bring us to God, being put to death in the flesh, but quickened by the Spirit:

occurrences.bsb: And this water symbolizes the baptism that now saves you also—not the removal of dirt from the body, but the pledge of a clear conscience toward God—through the resurrection of Jesus Christ,
occurrences.kjv: The like figure whereunto even baptism doth also now save us (not the putting away of the filth of the flesh, but the answer of a good conscience toward God,) by the resurrection of Jesus Christ:

occurrences.bsb: Therefore, since Christ suffered in His body, arm yourselves with the same resolve, because anyone who has suffered in his body is done with sin.
occurrences.kjv: Forasmuch then as Christ hath suffered for us in the flesh, arm yourselves likewise with the same mind: for he that hath suffered in the flesh hath ceased from sin;

occurrences.bsb: If anyone speaks, he should speak as one conveying the words of God. If anyone serves, he should serve with the strength God provides, so that in all things God may be glorified through Jesus Christ, to whom be the glory and the power forever and ever. Amen.
occurrences.kjv: If any man speak, let him speak as the oracles of God; if any man minister, let him do it as of the ability which God giveth: that God in all things may be glorified through Jesus Christ, to whom be praise and dominion for ever and ever. Amen.

occurrences.bsb: But rejoice that you share in the sufferings of Christ, so that you may be overjoyed at the revelation of His glory.
occurrences.kjv: But rejoice, inasmuch as ye are partakers of Christ’s sufferings; that, when his glory shall be revealed, ye may be glad also with exceeding joy.

occurrences.bsb: If you are insulted for the name of Christ, you are blessed, because the Spirit of glory and of God rests on you.
occurrences.kjv: If ye be reproached for the name of Christ, happy are ye; for the spirit of glory and of God resteth upon you: on their part he is evil spoken of, but on your part he is glorified.

occurrences.bsb: As a fellow elder, a witness of Christ’s sufferings, and a partaker of the glory to be revealed, I appeal to the elders among you:
occurrences.kjv: The elders which are among you I exhort, who am also an elder, and a witness of the sufferings of Christ, and also a partaker of the glory that shall be revealed:

occurrences.bsb: And after you have suffered for a little while, the God of all grace, who has called you to His eternal glory in Christ, will Himself restore you, secure you, strengthen you, and establish you.
occurrences.kjv: But the God of all grace, who hath called us unto his eternal glory by Christ Jesus, after that ye have suffered a while, make you perfect, stablish, strengthen, settle you.

occurrences.bsb: Greet one another with a kiss of love. Peace to all of you who are in Christ.
occurrences.kjv: Greet ye one another with a kiss of charity. Peace be with you all that are in Christ Jesus. Amen.

occurrences.bsb: Simon Peter, a servant and apostle of Jesus Christ, To those who through the righteousness of our God and Savior Jesus Christ have received a faith as precious as ours:
occurrences.kjv: Simon Peter, a servant and an apostle of Jesus Christ, to them that have obtained like precious faith with us through the righteousness of God and our Saviour Jesus Christ:

occurrences.bsb: For if you possess these qualities and continue to grow in them, they will keep you from being ineffective and unproductive in your knowledge of our Lord Jesus Christ.
occurrences.kjv: For if these things be in you, and abound, they make you that ye shall neither be barren nor unfruitful in the knowledge of our Lord Jesus Christ.

occurrences.bsb: and you will receive a lavish reception into the eternal kingdom of our Lord and Savior Jesus Christ.
occurrences.kjv: For so an entrance shall be ministered unto you abundantly into the everlasting kingdom of our Lord and Saviour Jesus Christ.

occurrences.bsb: because I know that this tent will soon be laid aside, as our Lord Jesus Christ has made clear to me.
occurrences.kjv: Knowing that shortly I must put off this my tabernacle, even as our Lord Jesus Christ hath shewed me.

occurrences.bsb: For we did not follow cleverly devised fables when we made known to you the power and coming of our Lord Jesus Christ, but we were eyewitnesses of His majesty.
occurrences.kjv: For we have not followed cunningly devised fables, when we made known unto you the power and coming of our Lord Jesus Christ, but were eyewitnesses of his majesty.

occurrences.bsb: If indeed they have escaped the corruption of the world through the knowledge of our Lord and Savior Jesus Christ, only to be entangled and overcome by it again, their final condition is worse than it was at first.
occurrences.kjv: For if after they have escaped the pollutions of the world through the knowledge of the Lord and Saviour Jesus Christ, they are again entangled therein, and overcome, the latter end is worse with them than the beginning.

occurrences.bsb: But grow in the grace and knowledge of our Lord and Savior Jesus Christ. To Him be the glory both now and to the day of eternity. Amen.
occurrences.kjv: But grow in grace, and in the knowledge of our Lord and Saviour Jesus Christ. To him be glory both now and for ever. Amen.

occurrences.bsb: We proclaim to you what we have seen and heard, so that you also may have fellowship with us. And this fellowship of ours is with the Father and with His Son, Jesus Christ.
occurrences.kjv: That which we have seen and heard declare we unto you, that ye also may have fellowship with us: and truly our fellowship is with the Father, and with his Son Jesus Christ.

occurrences.bsb: My little children, I am writing these things to you so that you will not sin. But if anyone does sin, we have an advocate before the Father—Jesus Christ, the Righteous One.
occurrences.kjv: My little children, these things write I unto you, that ye sin not. And if any man sin, we have an advocate with the Father, Jesus Christ the righteous:

occurrences.bsb: Who is the liar, if it is not the one who denies that Jesus is the Christ? This is the antichrist, who denies the Father and the Son.
occurrences.kjv: Who is a liar but he that denieth that Jesus is the Christ? He is antichrist, that denieth the Father and the Son.

occurrences.bsb: And this is His commandment: that we should believe in the name of His Son, Jesus Christ, and we should love one another just as He commanded us.
occurrences.kjv: And this is his commandment, That we should believe on the name of his Son Jesus Christ, and love one another, as he gave us commandment.

occurrences.bsb: By this you will know the Spirit of God: Every spirit that confesses that Jesus Christ has come in the flesh is from God,
occurrences.kjv: Hereby know ye the Spirit of God: Every spirit that confesseth that Jesus Christ is come in the flesh is of God:

occurrences.bsb: Everyone who believes that Jesus is the Christ has been born of God, and everyone who loves the Father also loves those born of Him.
occurrences.kjv: Whosoever believeth that Jesus is the Christ is born of God: and every one that loveth him that begat loveth him also that is begotten of him.

occurrences.bsb: This is the One who came by water and blood, Jesus Christ—not by water alone, but by water and blood. And it is the Spirit who testifies to this, because the Spirit is the truth.
occurrences.kjv: This is he that came by water and blood, even Jesus Christ; not by water only, but by water and blood. And it is the Spirit that beareth witness, because the Spirit is truth.

occurrences.bsb: And we know that the Son of God has come and has given us understanding, so that we may know Him who is true; and we are in Him who is true—in His Son Jesus Christ. He is the true God and eternal life.
occurrences.kjv: And we know that the Son of God is come, and hath given us an understanding, that we may know him that is true, and we are in him that is true, even in his Son Jesus Christ. This is the true God, and eternal life.

occurrences.bsb: Grace, mercy, and peace from God the Father and from Jesus Christ, the Son of the Father, will be with us in truth and love.
occurrences.kjv: Grace be with you, mercy, and peace, from God the Father, and from the Lord Jesus Christ, the Son of the Father, in truth and love.

occurrences.bsb: For many deceivers have gone out into the world, refusing to confess the coming of Jesus Christ in the flesh. Any such person is the deceiver and the antichrist.
occurrences.kjv: For many deceivers are entered into the world, who confess not that Jesus Christ is come in the flesh. This is a deceiver and an antichrist.

occurrences.bsb: Anyone who runs ahead without remaining in the teaching of Christ does not have God. Whoever remains in His teaching has both the Father and the Son.
occurrences.kjv: Whosoever transgresseth, and abideth not in the doctrine of Christ, hath not God. He that abideth in the doctrine of Christ, he hath both the Father and the Son.

occurrences.bsb: Jude, a servant of Jesus Christ and a brother of James, To those who are called, loved by God the Father, and kept in Jesus Christ:
occurrences.kjv: Jude, the servant of Jesus Christ, and brother of James, to them that are sanctified by God the Father, and preserved in Jesus Christ, and called:

occurrences.bsb: For certain men have crept in among you unnoticed—ungodly ones who were designated long ago for condemnation. They turn the grace of our God into a license for immorality, and they deny our only Master and Lord, Jesus Christ.
occurrences.kjv: For there are certain men crept in unawares, who were before of old ordained to this condemnation, ungodly men, turning the grace of our God into lasciviousness, and denying the only Lord God, and our Lord Jesus Christ.

occurrences.bsb: But you, beloved, remember what was foretold by the apostles of our Lord Jesus Christ
occurrences.kjv: But, beloved, remember ye the words which were spoken before of the apostles of our Lord Jesus Christ;

occurrences.bsb: keep yourselves in the love of God as you await the mercy of our Lord Jesus Christ to bring you eternal life.
occurrences.kjv: Keep yourselves in the love of God, looking for the mercy of our Lord Jesus Christ unto eternal life.

occurrences.bsb: to the only God our Savior be glory, majesty, dominion, and authority through Jesus Christ our Lord before all time, and now, and for all eternity. Amen.
occurrences.kjv: To the only wise God our Saviour, be glory and majesty, dominion and power, both now and ever. Amen.

occurrences.bsb: This is the revelation of Jesus Christ, which God gave Him to show His servants what must soon come to pass. He made it known by sending His angel to His servant John,
occurrences.kjv: The Revelation of Jesus Christ, which God gave unto him, to shew unto his servants things which must shortly come to pass; and he sent and signified it by his angel unto his servant John:

occurrences.bsb: who testifies to everything he saw. This is the word of God and the testimony of Jesus Christ.
occurrences.kjv: Who bare record of the word of God, and of the testimony of Jesus Christ, and of all things that he saw.

occurrences.bsb: and from Jesus Christ, the faithful witness, the firstborn from the dead, and the ruler of the kings of the earth. To Him who loves us and has released us from our sins by His blood,
occurrences.kjv: And from Jesus Christ, who is the faithful witness, and the first begotten of the dead, and the prince of the kings of the earth. Unto him that loved us, and washed us from our sins in his own blood,

occurrences.bsb: Then the seventh angel sounded his trumpet, and loud voices called out in heaven: “The kingdom of the world has become the kingdom of our Lord and of His Christ, and He will reign forever and ever.”
occurrences.kjv: And the seventh angel sounded; and there were great voices in heaven, saying, The kingdoms of this world are become the kingdoms of our Lord, and of his Christ; and he shall reign for ever and ever.

occurrences.bsb: And I heard a loud voice in heaven saying: “Now have come the salvation and the power and the kingdom of our God, and the authority of His Christ. For the accuser of our brothers has been thrown down—he who accuses them day and night before our God.
occurrences.kjv: And I heard a loud voice saying in heaven, Now is come salvation, and strength, and the kingdom of our God, and the power of his Christ: for the accuser of our brethren is cast down, which accused them before our God day and night.

occurrences.bsb: Then I saw the thrones, and those seated on them had been given authority to judge. And I saw the souls of those who had been beheaded for their testimony of Jesus and for the word of God, and those who had not worshiped the beast or its image and had not received its mark on their foreheads or hands. And they came to life and reigned with Christ for a thousand years.
occurrences.kjv: And I saw thrones, and they sat upon them, and judgment was given unto them: and I saw the souls of them that were beheaded for the witness of Jesus, and for the word of God, and which had not worshipped the beast, neither his image, neither had received his mark upon their foreheads, or in their hands; and they lived and reigned with Christ a thousand years.

occurrences.bsb: Blessed and holy are those who share in the first resurrection! The second death has no power over them, but they will be priests of God and of Christ and will reign with Him for a thousand years.
occurrences.kjv: Blessed and holy is he that hath part in the first resurrection: on such the second death hath no power, but they shall be priests of God and of Christ, and shall reign with him a thousand years.
